name: yacht

scripts.optimize-boat: gltf-transform optimize assets/swedish_royal_yacht_amadis.glb public/assets/boats/amadis.glb --texture-compress webp --texture-size 2048 --compress meshopt --flatten false --join false
scripts.optimize-jollyboat: gltf-transform optimize assets/wooden_boat.glb public/assets/boats/jollyboat.glb --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --compress meshopt --flatten false --join false
scripts.optimize-hands: gltf-transform optimize assets/hands_model_rigged.glb public/assets/fpv/hands.glb --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --compress meshopt --flatten false --join false --prune false

description: Lagoon sailing game — Three.js + Clearwater-derived water
